title: The Hen on the Bed
lines: Ben has a pet hen and lets it in.
The hen sat in the wet fog.
It naps on his red bed.
Ben gets in bed. It is wet!
Mom gets a rag and Dad gets a mop.
Ben sets a bed of rags in a bin.
The hen naps in the bin. Ben nods.

questions.listenFor: The hen sat in the fog and then napped on the bed. If they only say "the hen," ask "and where had the hen been?"

questions.ask: What do Mom and Dad get to clean up?
questions.listenFor: Mom gets a rag and Dad gets a mop. This is stated right in the story - have them reread that line if they cannot find it.

questions.ask: Do you think the hen will nap in the bin again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason from the story, like "yes, Ben made it a bed of rags," not just yes or no.
